paper_title: Rethinking the Role of Prompting Strategies in LLM Test-Time Scaling A   Perspective of Probability Theory
caption: Results of combining adaptively scaling and dynamically choosing the optimal i on GPT-4o-mini on MATH.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
This line chart illustrates the accuracy of six different prompting strategies as a function of sampling time, ranging from 0 to 25. The chart compares the performance of these strategies across varying sampling times to demonstrate how their accuracy evolves.

The horizontal axis, labeled "Sampling Time", is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 25, with tick marks and labels at regular intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy", is also a linear scale, ranging from 66 to 87, with tick marks and labels at regular intervals of 1. Both axes are marked with numerical values.

The chart contains six distinct lines, each representing a different prompting strategy:

- The purple line, labeled "DiP", starts at an accuracy of approximately 71.5 at sampling time 0, rises to a peak of about 78.5 at sampling time 10, and then gradually declines to approximately 77.5 at sampling time 25.
- The orange line, labeled "AnP", begins at an accuracy of 66 at sampling time 0, increases to a peak of approximately 72.5 at sampling time 5, and then fluctuates slightly, ending at approximately 71.5 at sampling time 25.
- The blue line, labeled "CoT", starts at an accuracy of approximately 69.5 at sampling time 0, rises to a peak of about 78 at sampling time 10, and then slightly declines to approximately 77.5 at sampling time 25.
- The black dashed line, labeled "Dynamic w/ Oracle", begins at an accuracy of approximately 85.5 at sampling time 0, remains relatively stable, with minor fluctuations, and ends at approximately 83.5 at sampling time 25.
- The cyan line, labeled "L2M", starts at an accuracy of approximately 70.5 at sampling time 0, rises to a peak of about 76.5 at sampling time 10, and then slightly declines to approximately 75.5 at sampling time 25.
- The red dotted line, labeled "Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle", begins at an accuracy of approximately 85.5 at sampling time 0, remains nearly constant, with minor fluctuations, and ends at approximately 87 at sampling time 25.
